card.name: Word after container before its contents
card.fires_on: The word 'containing' right after an infusion bag, container or vial in dilution steps, where a volume of fluid is about to be named. It also fires on other words that bring in something already present.

modes.label: Container containing fluid
modes.description: 'containing' after a bag, vial or container, just before a volume of diluent.

modes.label: Already-present things
modes.description: Words like running or existing that refer to something already in place, such as an IV line.
modes.example: Flush an<< existing>> intravenous line with 0.9

modes.label: Comma before descriptive add-on
modes.description: A comma after a group or place, before a clause describing what was already there.
modes.example: They moved into the Zagros Mountains (inhabited by Gutians, Kassites and others<<,>> home of the Mannaean kingdom)

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning 'already' or 'existing', suggesting something already present in the setting.
card.plain: It marks the spot where text describes what is already in a bag, line or place.
